title: Among the male superheroes, list the super hero names of superheroes with w
question:
Among the male superheroes, list the super hero names of superheroes with weight greater than the 79% average weight of all superheroes.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: super hero names refers to superhero_name;male superheros refers to gender = 'Male';Calculation = weight_kg > MULTIPLY(AVG(weight_kg), 0.79)

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_019
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Male'
  AND s.XCL_029 > 0.79 * (SELECT AVG(XCL_029) FROM superhero)
